codeReview.summary: The command covers most required behavior (intent/budget flags, tiered output, show-all mode, cloud fallback visibility, and edge-case handling), but two blocking gaps remain: it performs an unintended file write in a display-only command path and it can emit a raw Python traceback when saved benchmark data is malformed.

issues.description: The no-profile path calls save_profile(profile), which writes ~/.mlx-stack/profile.json. The feature is specified as display-only/no files written, so recommend should not persist profile data as a side effect.

Saved benchmark values are cast with float(...) without validation or error handling. If benchmark JSON contains non-numeric values (e.g., "gen_tps": "abc"), ValueError propagates past recommend's ScoringError-only handler and prints a full traceback. Reproduced by running recommend with MLX_STACK_HOME pointing to a profile plus benchmarks/<profile_id>.json containing invalid numeric strings.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Feature metadata uses skillName "cli-feature", but the worker runtime could not invoke that skill even though the skill file exists in-repo.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Validation contract expectation for the zero-model edge case is stale versus current catalog/hardware behavior.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: validation-contract.md line 183 expects `recommend --budget 1gb` to produce no-fit error, but the worker transcript/handoff notes 1GB still fits the 0.8B model and used 0.5GB to trigger the no-fit path.

summary: Reviewed handoff, transcript skeleton, and commit 2c5fbc7 for recommend-command. The feature is close, but fails review due to a display-only contract violation (auto-saving profile) and a reproducible traceback path on malformed saved benchmark data.
